goals.objective: Keep health_score at 100 with warning_count at 0.
goals.rationale: OS-3/OS-4 baseline is the stability contract for every later layer.

goals.objective: Maintain parse_error_count at 0 across skills and orchestration reports.
goals.rationale: Parsed reports must stay clean so later layers can compose safely.

goals.objective: Keep daemon cycles bounded and successful.
goals.rationale: Repeated bounded cycles are the safest local automation contract.

goals.objective: Keep knowledge graph dense enough for routing but additive-only.
goals.rationale: Graph structure should remain analyzable as later layers read it.

goals.objective: Keep the system ready for meta-adaptation, policy, and enterprise layers.
goals.rationale: Later OS layers depend on current reports being readable and additive.

goals.objective: Track hot nodes and graph density so future refactors stay additive.
goals.rationale: Dense graphs can become hard to reason about as layers grow.

goals.objective: Feed reasoning-derived hints into the strategy layer.
goals.rationale: The reasoning engine already synthesizes signals that the goals layer can reuse.

priorities.reason: Baseline health must stay at 100 and warnings at 0.
